newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Banco Roberts places $50 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Banco Roberts places $50 mln in notes.

text.p: Argentina's Banco Roberts said Wednesday it has successfully placed $50 million in medium-term subordinated notes due 2002 at a price of 99.0.
The bank said in a statement the notes carry a coupon of 8.75 percent and will be listed on the Luxembourg and Buenos Aires stock exchanges.
The notes, which were sold mainly to international investors, were issued under the bank's existing $200 million medium-term note program, said Banco Roberts.
"The subordination feature enables the bank to compute the proceeds as capital under central bank regulations," it added.
